items.title: When the tensor product of two glued dimension-one local rings misses K there is a common dominating DVR
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file varieties.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: One direction is clear; the other builds a valuation ring of K dominating the local ring C_m of the image C of A  tensor  B -> K at a nonzero maximal ideal, and then runs Krull-Akizuki to get Noetherianity, hence a DVR. H2: the argument is a short chain of named algebra lemmas with the choice of the dominating valuation ring as the only non-mechanical step.
